newsitem.title: USA: Mobil to market US Gulf crude pipeline space.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to market US Gulf crude pipeline space.

text.p: Mobil Co said it will market the Eugene Island Flowline System and Burns Terminal to third-party companies, with the intent of reaching potential offshore participants in the Gulf of Mexico area.
Mobil said the decision marks a departure from past practices.
The Flowline System, with 24-hour dock and terminal, also consists of an offshore crude oil pipeline with total capacity of 50,000 barrels per day.
The Eugene Island Flowline System is an undivided-interest pipeline, operated by Mobil Eugene Island Pipe Line Co.
